commands.title: HoldTableForReservation

fields.name: tableNumber
fields.mapping: chosen by the Hold Table For Reservation processor - the lowest table number it has not yet tried for this reservation. The command itself rejects a table that is blocked or already held, so the processor needs no occupancy data.

commands.description: The hold is keyed by tableNumber and must replay the same stream the TableBlocked events of the BlockTable slice already use, so a block and a hold on the same table are visible to one another.

fields.name: tableNumber
fields.mapping: HoldTableForReservation.tableNumber - the table stream this hold is appended to, so two processors racing for the same table cannot both win

processors.title: Hold Table For Reservation
processors.description: Polls AutoSeatingCandidates for rows with autoSeatingOutcome 'Pending' and issues HoldTableForReservation for each. The processor picks the table itself: it walks table numbers 1 to 20 in ascending order and issues the command for the first one it has not already tried for this reservation, stopping as soon as one is accepted. A rejection (table blocked, or already held for that window) is expected and not an error - the processor moves on to the next table number. If every table rejects, the row stays 'Pending' and the staff seat the party manually. There is no seat-capacity data in this system, so numberOfPeople is carried for the staff to see but does not constrain the pick.

then.description: Table 12 is already held for reservation R-7K2Q from 19:00 to 21:00 on 15.04.2026 - two reservations cannot hold the same table at the same time. This is the race the reservation pattern exists to lose safely: the second processor is rejected, its reservation returns to the queue and picks a different candidate table.
